title: Source-pinned x86-64 teaching slice
statement: The x86-64 teaching slice is the exact 64-bit user-mode instruction-form, state, encoding, exception, and ABI subset named by a versioned source manifest.

formal.statement: X64Slice = source revision x state subset x encoding subset x instruction forms x exclusions

notes: The exact source revision and instruction-form list must be pinned before architectural claims use this object.
